authority.note: This file is routing data, not authorization. Root AGENTS.md and GitHub rulesets override this contract.

workflow: DISCOVER: current main SHA, PR head SHA, issue and roadmap evidence
CORRELATE: files, contracts, risks, competing PRs
IMPLEMENT: smallest reversible scope, existing branch when appropriate
VERIFY: positive and negative tests, relevant CI and security gates
RELEASE: squash only when every current required gate and review is verified
OBSERVE: post-merge main, deployment and health readback separately
restrictions: No bypass of GitHub branch protection or required security gates
No production database, OAuth, secrets, provider or paid-resource mutation without separate authorization and recovery evidence
No fabricated CI exit codes, runtime states, revenue or efficiency gains
No publication of unlicensed data or media

orchestration.writeSerialization: one active scope branch at a time
orchestration.conflictRule: compare changed filenames and shared contracts before writing
orchestration.checkpointing: persist source-bound evidence and exact commit/run IDs
